import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
MASK=(1<<64)-1
def fp(b):
 h=0
 for x in b:h=(h*257+x+1)&MASK
 return {'n':len(b),'h':f'{h:016x}'}
seed='S';coordn='case/0/frame/0/h/0/n';coordv='case/0/frame/0/h/0/v'
hn=hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}/{coordn}/0'.encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
hv=hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}/{coordv}/0'.encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
name=('N'+hn).encode();value=('V'+hv).encode()
action=(0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'H'+(1).to_bytes(8,'big')+len(name).to_bytes(8,'big')+name+len(value).to_bytes(8,'big')+value+b'\1'
d={'seed':seed,'definitions':[],'timeout_ms':1,'cases':[{'name':'a','frames':[{'Type':'headers','End_Stream':True,'data_to_transfered':[['N<<random_string>>','V<<random_string>>']]}],'expect':{'method':'GET','target':'/','host':'h'}}],'events':[],'channels':[]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'],input=json.dumps(d).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE);o=json.loads(p.stdout);print(o['cases'][0]['sent'],fp(action),o['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'],len(name)+len(value))
